title: Clarify dispatch ordering in defense-in-depth comment
description:
File: crates/kith-jmap/src/lib.rs, line 335.

Comment says 'Role check MUST precede handler lookup (defense-in-depth)' but omits that ResultReference resolution (line 331) happens before the role check. This ordering matters: Peer callers can trigger resolution errors before authorization is verified.

The comment should clarify the actual sequence: resolve ResultReferences first, then role-check, then handler lookup. Or explain why early resolution is safe.
